name: BattlePad
description: Shortcuts for the battle menu: moves and battle actions mapped straight to your controller. The d-pad fires the four moves, the face buttons are FIGHT / RUN (held) / POKEMON / PACK, the left stick picks moves radially, and the next action queues while the foe is still attacking. Button glyphs match the pad in your hands -- Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo -- and every choice runs the vanilla battle code underneath, on Red, Blue, Yellow and Gold.
